meta.title: Cookie policy
meta.description: Which cookies and similar technologies {companyName} uses on this website, and how to manage your choices.

title: Cookie policy
intro: We keep this website as light as possible. No optional cookie or tracking script is used until you have made a choice, and you can change your mind at any time.

sections.title: What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small files that a website stores in your browser. Similar technologies, such as local storage, work in the same way. The rules on consent apply to all of them.

sections.title: Strictly necessary
paragraphs: These are needed for the website to work and do not require consent.
list: Your cookie choice: stored in your browser's local storage under the name "cookie-consent", for 12 months, so that we do not ask you again on every page.
Back-office session: a secure cookie set only when our staff sign in to the administration area. Visitors never receive it.

sections.title: Audience measurement (optional)
paragraphs: If you accept it, we load [Plausible Analytics], a privacy-friendly service hosted in the European Union. It counts page visits anonymously, does not use cookies, does not track you across websites and does not collect personal data.
We still ask for your consent before loading it, and nothing is loaded if you decline.

sections.title: What we do not use
paragraphs: We do not use advertising cookies, social media trackers or cross-site profiling.

sections.title: Links to other services
paragraphs: Our WhatsApp button opens WhatsApp, which is operated by a third party under its own privacy and cookie policies.

sections.title: Managing your choice
paragraphs: You can change your choice at any time with the "Cookie settings" link at the bottom of every page. You can also clear stored data in your browser settings; we will then ask you again.
For any question, contact us at {email}.
